reading: Technician reconciliation spans three transitions (admission, transfer, discharge) and three layers that shape safety: what task the technician does, who supervises and how, and what the regulator allows. The retrieved evidence is densest for admission histories (claim c1), thin for discharge (claim c2), and bounded by jurisdiction-specific scope (claim c3). Outcomes are measured inconsistently (claim c4), so the review must chart definitions rather than compare numbers.
